file.content:
name: Release & Publish

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  # Finishes a release that stopped, and refreshes the release PR, without waiting for a push.
  schedule:
    - cron: '23 5 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release_source_sha:
        description: 'Merged Callisto release-PR commit to recover; leave empty for the oldest unfinished release or the triggering commit.'
        required: false
        type: string

# Registry credentials exist only inside `execute`.
permissions: {}

# Per-commit group: a shared group would drop a queued release merge.
concurrency:
  group: release-${{ github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  # Keep in lockstep with .prototools.
  RUST_VERSION: "1.98.1"
  # `callisto release pending` reads the committed decision of each of the 10 newest release commits,
  # and fails with E166 on older ones whose decision no longer decodes. Count this release and newer.
  RELEASE_PENDING_FROM: 2daef9276b234fcc04d8994d91210eeccd88d7e8

jobs:
  release-candidate:
    name: Identify a merged Callisto release PR
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    timeout-minutes: 10
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      is_release_pr: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.is_release_pr }}
      release_source_sha: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@ff116694c00f08ce7edc3f1b00ed4fa1d6ffd084 # callisto@0.17.0
        with:
          version: callisto@0.17.0
          verification: require
      - id: candidate
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT: ${{ inputs.release_source_sha }}
          TRIGGERING_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          release_source_sha="$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT"
          selected_pending=false
          if [[ -z "$release_source_sha" ]]; then
            # Oldest unfinished release first: a failed release is finished before a newer one starts.
            release_source_sha=$(callisto --format json release pending --from "$RELEASE_PENDING_FROM" | jq -r '.pending[0].source // empty')
            if [[ -n "$release_source_sha" ]]; then
              selected_pending=true
            elif [[ "$EVENT_NAME" == push ]]; then
              release_source_sha="$TRIGGERING_SHA"
            else
              # A scheduled run with nothing unfinished only refreshes the release PR.
              echo 'is_release_pr=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
          fi
          if [[ ! "$release_source_sha" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::release_source_sha must be exactly 40 lowercase hex characters"
            exit 1
          fi
          resolved_sha=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}" --jq '.sha')
          if [[ "$resolved_sha" != "$release_source_sha" ]]; then
            echo "::error::release_source_sha does not resolve to that exact commit"
            exit 1
          fi
          if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$release_source_sha" "$TRIGGERING_SHA"; then
            echo "::error::release_source_sha is not on main's history"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Scheduling hint only; `callisto release plan` is the authority. A trusted release commit is
          # the merge of the managed PR and a GitHub-verified signed commit, never a direct push.
          prs=$(gh api --paginate "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}/pulls" | jq -s --arg repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --arg sha "$release_source_sha" '[.[][] | select(.merged_at != null and .merge_commit_sha == $sha and .base.ref == "main" and .head.repo.full_name == $repo and (.head.ref == "callisto/version-packages" or (.head.ref | test("^callisto/version-packages--[0-9a-f]{40}$")))) | .number]')
          verified=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}" --jq '.commit.verification.verified')
          if [[ "$(jq 'length' <<< "$prs")" == 1 && "$verified" == true ]]; then
            {
              echo 'is_release_pr=true'
              echo "release_source_sha=$release_source_sha"
            } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif [[ "$selected_pending" == true || -n "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT" || "$(jq 'length' <<< "$prs")" != 0 ]]; then
            echo "::error::release source is not one verified merged managed PR"
            exit 1
          else
            echo 'is_release_pr=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  version-pr:
    name: Create or update the Callisto release PR
    needs: [release-candidate, drain]
    # `drain` is skipped unless a release just executed. Refresh the PR when this is not a release run,
    # or when the release that just ran left nothing unfinished.
    if: >-
      always() && needs.release-candidate.result == 'success' &&
      ((needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr != 'true' &&
        needs.drain.result == 'skipped' && inputs.release_source_sha == '') ||
       (needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr == 'true' &&
        needs.drain.result == 'success' && needs.drain.outputs.has_pending == 'false'))
    timeout-minutes: 15
    concurrency:
      group: version-pr
      cancel-in-progress: false
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      CARGO_TERM_COLOR: never
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      # Pinned here, not inherited from the action's default.
      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@ff116694c00f08ce7edc3f1b00ed4fa1d6ffd084 # callisto@0.17.0
        with:
          version: callisto@0.17.0
          verification: require
      - name: Compose, version, and open the release PR
        uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/callisto-action@ff116694c00f08ce7edc3f1b00ed4fa1d6ffd084 # callisto@0.17.0
        with:
          setup_callisto: 'false'
          branch: main
          release_branch: callisto/version-packages
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

  plan:
    name: Derive release intent from the merged release commit
    needs: release-candidate
    if: needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 20
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      CARGO_TERM_COLOR: never
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      has_artifacts: ${{ steps.slots.outputs.has_artifacts }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@ff116694c00f08ce7edc3f1b00ed4fa1d6ffd084 # callisto@0.17.0
        with:
          version: callisto@0.17.0
          verification: require
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          path: release-source
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      # The orchestration revision is this run's own SHA: the build job's attestations are stamped with it.
      - name: Derive and hash intent
        env:
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          handoff_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          mkdir -p "$handoff_dir"
          callisto release plan \
            --source-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source" \
            --orchestration-revision "$GITHUB_SHA" \
            --artifact-repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --from-release-commit "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA" \
            --decision "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source/.callisto/release-decision.json" \
            --out "$handoff_dir/release-intent.json"
          # Relative name: the consumers verify from another job's RUNNER_TEMP.
          (cd "$handoff_dir" && shasum -a 256 release-intent.json > release-intent.json.sha256)
      # Slots exist only when the product package is in this release.
      - name: Read declared artifact slot count
        id: slots
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Own statement: set -e cannot see a substitution failing inside an echo argument.
          has_artifacts=$(jq '.artifactSlots | length > 0' "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent/release-intent.json")
          case "$has_artifacts" in
            true|false) ;;
            *) echo "::error::artifact slot probe returned '$has_artifacts'"; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          echo "has_artifacts=$has_artifacts" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
          if-no-files-found: error
          # Long enough to re-run `execute` after a multi-day diagnosis.
          retention-days: 7

  build:
    name: Build ${{ matrix.platform }}
    needs: [release-candidate, plan]
    timeout-minutes: 45
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.host }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      # Build provenance for the GitHub Release assets.
      attestations: write
      id-token: write
    strategy:
      fail-fast: true
      matrix:
        # `target` and `asset` must match `[[release.artifact]]` in callisto.toml.
        include:
          - { host: macos-latest, target: aarch64-apple-darwin, platform: darwin-arm64, bin: caliper-docgen, asset: caliper-docgen-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz }
          - { host: macos-latest, target: x86_64-apple-darwin, platform: darwin-x64, bin: caliper-docgen, asset: caliper-docgen-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz }
          - { host: ubuntu-latest, target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, platform: linux-x64-gnu, bin: caliper-docgen, asset: caliper-docgen-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz }
          - { host: ubuntu-latest, target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, platform: linux-arm64-gnu, bin: caliper-docgen, asset: caliper-docgen-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz, zig: true }
          - { host: windows-latest, target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc, platform: win32-x64-msvc, bin: caliper-docgen.exe, asset: caliper-docgen-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.tar.gz }
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      # No caches in release builds.
      - uses: moonrepo/setup-toolchain@261c62cb5b0f580c7be7c8cd0f023a2e96756095 # v0.6.4
        with:
          auto-install: true
          cache: false
      - run: |
          rustup toolchain install "$RUST_VERSION" --profile minimal --target "$TARGET" --no-self-update
          rustup default "$RUST_VERSION"
        env:
          TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
      - if: matrix.zig
        uses: mlugg/setup-zig@d1434d08867e3ee9daa34448df10607b98908d29 # v2.2.1
        with:
          version: 0.14.1
          use-cache: false
      - if: matrix.zig
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@8cca0918f8471c33515202b73f56ab27f2bed283 # v2.87.29
        with:
          tool: cargo-zigbuild
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --filter caliper-docgen-napi
      - name: Build napi addon
        working-directory: packages/napi
        env:
          TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
          ZIG: ${{ matrix.zig }}
        run: pnpm napi build --platform --release --target "$TARGET" ${ZIG:+--cross-compile} --manifest-path ../../crates/binding/Cargo.toml --output-dir .
      - name: Build CLI binary
        env:
          TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
          ZIG: ${{ matrix.zig }}
        run: cargo "${ZIG:+zig}build" --release --locked -p caliper-docgen --target "$TARGET"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: napi-${{ matrix.platform }}
          path: packages/napi/caliper_docgen_napi.${{ matrix.platform }}.node
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: cli-${{ matrix.platform }}
          path: target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/${{ matrix.bin }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
      # Relative paths throughout: GNU tar on the Windows runner reads `D:\` as a remote host.
      - name: Archive the CLI release asset
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true'
        env:
          TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
          BIN: ${{ matrix.bin }}
          ASSET: ${{ matrix.asset }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p release-assets
          tar -C "target/${TARGET}/release" -czf "release-assets/${ASSET}" "$BIN"
      - name: Attest the exact asset bytes
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true'
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: release-assets/${{ matrix.asset }}
      - name: Upload the release asset
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release-asset-${{ matrix.platform }}
          path: release-assets/${{ matrix.asset }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  assemble:
    name: Assemble the attested release assets
    needs: [release-candidate, plan, build]
    if: needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@ff116694c00f08ce7edc3f1b00ed4fa1d6ffd084 # callisto@0.17.0
        with:
          version: callisto@0.17.0
          verification: require
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
      # Every matrix target's asset, so a target added to the matrix cannot be built and then left out of the manifest.
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          pattern: release-asset-*
          merge-multiple: true
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts
      - name: Create the exact artifact manifest
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          (cd "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent" && shasum -a 256 -c release-intent.json.sha256)
          callisto release artifact-manifest \
            --intent "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent/release-intent.json" \
            --artifact-dir "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-artifacts" \
            --out "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-artifacts/manifest.json"
      # One artifact holding both directories keeps the intent and the manifest from different runs from being mixed.
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release-build
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
            ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  execute:
    name: Execute approved release
    needs: [release-candidate, plan, build, assemble]
    # A release without the product package has no assets, so `assemble` is skipped by design;
    # a failed or cancelled `build` or `assemble` must still block. `!cancelled()`, not `always()`:
    # cancelling the run must stop the one irreversible job.
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.plan.result == 'success' && needs.build.result == 'success' &&
      (needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'false' || needs.assemble.result == 'success')
    timeout-minutes: 60
    concurrency:
      group: release-execute
      cancel-in-progress: false
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Merging the release PR is the approval; no environment gate.
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      # `gh attestation verify` of the release assets.
      attestations: read
    env:
      NPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE: "true"
      # Callisto parses `cargo info` stdout; forced color wraps its `version:` label in escapes (E176).
      CARGO_TERM_COLOR: never
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@ff116694c00f08ce7edc3f1b00ed4fa1d6ffd084 # callisto@0.17.0
        with:
          version: callisto@0.17.0
          verification: require
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          path: release-source
          fetch-depth: 0
          # Tag dispatch pushes from here.
          persist-credentials: true
      # Outside release-source: callisto rejects non-ignored untracked files there.
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
      # Outside the checkout too: execute needs a clean release-source worktree.
      - if: needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-build
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-build
      - name: Verify same-run handoff before credentials
        env:
          HAS_ARTIFACTS: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          intent_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          build_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-build"
          (cd "$intent_dir" && shasum -a 256 -c release-intent.json.sha256)
          if [[ "$HAS_ARTIFACTS" == true ]]; then
            cmp "$intent_dir/release-intent.json" "$build_dir/release-intent/release-intent.json"
          fi
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          pattern: napi-*
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-artifacts
          merge-multiple: true
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          pattern: cli-*
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/cli-artifacts
      - uses: moonrepo/setup-toolchain@261c62cb5b0f580c7be7c8cd0f023a2e96756095 # v0.6.4
        with:
          auto-install: true
          cache: false
      - name: Install deps and place platform binaries
        working-directory: release-source
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
          (cd packages/napi && pnpm napi artifacts --output-dir "${RUNNER_TEMP}/napi-artifacts")
          for dir in "${RUNNER_TEMP}"/cli-artifacts/cli-*; do
            platform="${dir##*/cli-}"
            dest="packages/cli/npm/${platform}"
            [[ -d "$dest" ]] || { echo "::error::no package dir for $platform"; exit 1; }
            mv "$dir"/* "$dest/"
            chmod +x "$dest"/caliper-docgen*
          done
          for dir in packages/napi/npm/* packages/cli/npm/*; do
            files=$(jq -r '.files[]' "$dir/package.json")
            for f in $files; do
              [[ -f "$dir/$f" ]] || { echo "::error::missing $dir/$f"; exit 1; }
            done
          done
      # npm and pnpm both read the user-level .npmrc.
      - name: Authenticate with the npm registry
        env:
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
        run: npm config set //registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken "$NPM_TOKEN"
      - name: Execute verified release
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          build_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-build"
          receipt_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-release-receipt/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
          mkdir -p "$receipt_dir"
          args=(
            --source-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source"
            --intent "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent/release-intent.json"
            --receipt "$receipt_dir/release-receipt.json"
            --orchestration-revision "$GITHUB_SHA"
          )
          if [[ -f "$build_dir/release-artifacts/manifest.json" ]]; then
            args+=(
              --artifact-manifest "$build_dir/release-artifacts/manifest.json"
              --artifact-dir "$build_dir/release-artifacts"
            )
          fi
          callisto release execute "${args[@]}"
      - name: Summarize receipt
        if: always()
        run: |
          receipt="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-release-receipt/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}/release-receipt.json"
          if [[ -f "$receipt" ]]; then
            {
              echo '### Release receipt'
              echo '```json'
              cat "$receipt"
              echo '```'
            } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi
      - name: Upload receipt
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          # Per attempt: a re-run keeps each attempt's receipt instead of replacing the last.
          name: release-receipt-attempt-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/callisto-release-receipt/${{ github.run_id }}
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7

  drain:
    name: Start the next unfinished release
    needs: [execute, release-candidate]
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.execute.result == 'success' &&
      needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      actions: write
      contents: read
    outputs:
      has_pending: ${{ steps.pending.outputs.has_pending }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@ff116694c00f08ce7edc3f1b00ed4fa1d6ffd084 # callisto@0.17.0
        with:
          version: callisto@0.17.0
          verification: require
      - name: Dispatch the oldest unfinished release
        id: pending
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # The release that just ran is excluded: one that cannot be read back as finished must not start itself again.
          next_sha=$(callisto --format json release pending --from "$RELEASE_PENDING_FROM" | jq -r --arg sha "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA" '[.pending[] | select(.source != $sha)][0].source // empty')
          if [[ -n "$next_sha" ]]; then
            gh workflow run callisto-release.yml --ref main -f release_source_sha="$next_sha"
            echo 'has_pending=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo 'has_pending=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

content.content:
1	# List available commands
2	default:
3	    @just --list
4	
5	# Install Cargo tools required for local development
6	install-tools:
7	    cargo install cargo-nextest --locked
8	    cargo install cargo-llvm-cov --locked
9	    cargo install cargo-machete --locked
10	    cargo install cargo-mutants --locked
11	    cargo install cargo-semver-checks --locked
12	    rustup component add llvm-tools-preview
13	
14	# Check the public Rust API of the core crate for SemVer breaks against the last published version. The version only
15	# moves in the release PR, so a break is accepted when a pending minor or major changeset covers the crate.
16	semver:
17	    #!/usr/bin/env bash
18	    set -uo pipefail
19	    if cargo semver-checks check-release -p caliper-docgen-core; then
20	        exit 0
21	    fi
22	    if grep -qsE '^cargo/caliper-docgen-core: (minor|major)$' .changeset/*.md; then
23	        echo "breaking API changes are covered by a pending minor or major changeset for caliper-docgen-core"
24	        exit 0
25	    fi
26	    echo "breaking API changes need a minor or major changeset for cargo/caliper-docgen-core" >&2
27	    exit 1
28	
29	# Build with the minimum supported Rust version declared in Cargo.toml.
30	msrv:
31	    cargo +$(sed -n 's/^rust-version = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' Cargo.toml) check --workspace --exclude caliper-docgen-napi --locked
32	
33	# Install all dependencies
34	install:
35	    pnpm install
36	    cargo fetch
37	
38	# Build all projects. Rust crates build via one workspace-wide cargo
39	# invocation, not `moon run :build` — that fans out one `cargo build -p`
40	# per crate, and every one of those processes contends for the same
41	# target/ file lock, serializing what moon's own scheduler thinks is
42	# parallel work (confirmed via `Blocking waiting for file lock` in verbose
43	# output). napi/vite-plugin have no such lock to contend over, so moon
44	# still orchestrates those directly.
45	build:
46	    cargo build --workspace --exclude caliper-docgen-napi
47	    moon run napi:build vite-plugin:build
48	    cargo build --release
49	
50	# Run all tests (Rust + TypeScript)
51	test: test-rust test-ts
52	
53	# Run Rust tests (via nextest, which doesn't run doctests — paired
54	# with `cargo test --doc` to cover those too)
55	test-rust:
56	    cargo nextest run --workspace --exclude caliper-docgen-napi --locked
57	    cargo test --doc --workspace --exclude caliper-docgen-napi
58	
59	# Run TypeScript tests
60	test-ts:
61	    pnpm --filter caliper-docgen-vite-plugin test
62	    pnpm --filter caliper-docgen-storybook test
63	    pnpm --filter caliper-docgen-oracle test
64	
65	# Build the native binding and run the Vite plugin against it
66	test-integration:
67	    pnpm --filter caliper-docgen-napi build:napi
68	    NAPI_BINARY_REQUIRED=true pnpm --filter caliper-docgen-vite-plugin test:integration
69	    NAPI_BINARY_REQUIRED=true pnpm --filter caliper-docgen-storybook test:integration
70	
71	# Pack the npm packages and check napi arrives only as vite-plugin's transitive dependency (pm: npm or pnpm)
72	verify-install pm="pnpm":
73	    scripts/verify-install.sh {{ pm }}
74	
75	# Run the criterion benchmarks (single fixtures); `just bench` compares a whole library against main
76	bench-criterion:
77	    cargo bench --workspace --exclude caliper-docgen-napi
78	
79	# Rust and TypeScript line coverage; with a threshold, fails if either is below it
80	coverage threshold="": (coverage-rust threshold) (coverage-ts threshold)
81	
82	# Rust coverage: writes lcov.info and prints the summary before enforcing the threshold
83	coverage-rust threshold="":
84	    #!/usr/bin/env bash
85	    set -euo pipefail
86	    cargo llvm-cov nextest --workspace --exclude caliper-docgen-napi --locked --lcov --output-path lcov.info
87	    cargo llvm-cov report --summary-only
88	    if [[ -n "{{ threshold }}" ]]; then
89	      cargo llvm-cov report --summary-only --fail-under-lines "{{ threshold }}"
90	    fi
91	
92	# TypeScript coverage: prints the summaries and writes each package's coverage/lcov.info
93	coverage-ts threshold="":
94	    pnpm --filter caliper-docgen-vite-plugin exec vitest run --coverage {{ if threshold != "" { "--coverage.thresholds.lines=" + threshold } else { "" } }}
95	    pnpm --filter caliper-docgen-storybook exec vitest run --coverage {{ if threshold != "" { "--coverage.thresholds.lines=" + threshold } else { "" } }}
96	
97	# Rust coverage report, opened in the browser
98	coverage-html:

# List available commands
default:
    @just --list

# Install Cargo tools required for local development
install-tools:
    cargo install cargo-nextest --locked
    cargo install cargo-llvm-cov --locked
    cargo install cargo-machete --locked
    cargo install cargo-mutants --locked
    cargo install cargo-semver-checks --locked
    rustup component add llvm-tools-preview

# Check the public Rust API of the core crate for SemVer breaks against the last published version. The version only
# moves in the release PR, so a break is accepted when a pending minor or major changeset covers the crate.
semver:
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -uo pipefail
    if cargo semver-checks check-release -p caliper-docgen-core; then
        exit 0
    fi
    if grep -qsE '^cargo/caliper-docgen-core: (minor|major)$' .changeset/*.md; then
        echo "breaking API changes are covered by a pending minor or major changeset for caliper-docgen-core"
        exit 0
    fi
    echo "breaking API changes need a minor or major changeset for cargo/caliper-docgen-core" >&2
    exit 1

# Build with the minimum supported Rust version declared in Cargo.toml.
msrv:
    cargo +$(sed -n 's/^rust-version = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' Cargo.toml) check --workspace --exclude caliper-docgen-napi --locked

# Install all dependencies
install:
    pnpm install
    cargo fetch

# Build all projects. Rust crates build via one workspace-wide cargo
# invocation, not `moon run :build` — that fans out one `cargo build -p`
# per crate, and every one of those processes contends for the same
# target/ file lock, serializing what moon's own scheduler thinks is
# parallel work (confirmed via `Blocking waiting for file lock` in verbose
# output). napi/vite-plugin have no such lock to contend over, so moon
# still orchestrates those directly.
build:
    cargo build --workspace --exclude caliper-docgen-napi
    moon run napi:build vite-plugin:build
    cargo build --release

# Run all tests (Rust + TypeScript)
test: test-rust test-ts

# Run Rust tests (via nextest, which doesn't run doctests — paired
# with `cargo test --doc` to cover those too)
test-rust:
    cargo nextest run --workspace --exclude caliper-docgen-napi --locked
    cargo test --doc --workspace --exclude caliper-docgen-napi

# Run TypeScript tests
test-ts:
    pnpm --filter caliper-docgen-vite-plugin test
    pnpm --filter caliper-docgen-storybook test
    pnpm --filter caliper-docgen-oracle test

# Build the native binding and run the Vite plugin against it
test-integration:
    pnpm --filter caliper-docgen-napi build:napi
    NAPI_BINARY_REQUIRED=true pnpm --filter caliper-docgen-vite-plugin test:integration
    NAPI_BINARY_REQUIRED=true pnpm --filter caliper-docgen-storybook test:integration

# Pack the npm packages and check napi arrives only as vite-plugin's transitive dependency (pm: npm or pnpm)
verify-install pm="pnpm":
    scripts/verify-install.sh {{ pm }}

# Run the criterion benchmarks (single fixtures); `just bench` compares a whole library against main
bench-criterion:
    cargo bench --workspace --exclude caliper-docgen-napi

# Rust and TypeScript line coverage; with a threshold, fails if either is below it
coverage threshold="": (coverage-rust threshold) (coverage-ts threshold)

# Rust coverage: writes lcov.info and prints the summary before enforcing the threshold
coverage-rust threshold="":
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -euo pipefail
    cargo llvm-cov nextest --workspace --exclude caliper-docgen-napi --locked --lcov --output-path lcov.info
    cargo llvm-cov report --summary-only
    if [[ -n "{{ threshold }}" ]]; then
      cargo llvm-cov report --summary-only --fail-under-lines "{{ threshold }}"
    fi

# TypeScript coverage: prints the summaries and writes each package's coverage/lcov.info
coverage-ts threshold="":
    pnpm --filter caliper-docgen-vite-plugin exec vitest run --coverage {{ if threshold != "" { "--coverage.thresholds.lines=" + threshold } else { "" } }}
    pnpm --filter caliper-docgen-storybook exec vitest run --coverage {{ if threshold != "" { "--coverage.thresholds.lines=" + threshold } else { "" } }}

# Rust coverage report, opened in the browser
coverage-html:
    cargo llvm-cov nextest --workspace --exclude caliper-docgen-napi --locked --html --open

# Documentation build check (warnings, including broken intra-doc links,
# treated as errors)
doc-check:
    RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps --workspace --exclude caliper-docgen-napi

# Unused-dependency check
machete:
    cargo machete

# Mutation testing sweep — slow, run on demand, not part of `just ci`
mutants:
    cargo mutants --workspace --exclude caliper-docgen-napi

ts_src := "'packages/vite-plugin/src/**/*.ts' 'packages/vite-plugin/tests/**/*.ts' 'packages/vite-plugin/vitest.config.ts' 'packages/storybook/src/**/*.ts' 'packages/storybook/tests/**/*.ts' 'packages/storybook/*.config.ts' 'packages/napi/*.d.ts' 'packages/cli/bin/**/*.js' 'apps/oracle/src/**/*.ts' 'apps/oracle/tests/**/*.ts'"
ts_src_only := "'packages/vite-plugin/src' 'packages/vite-plugin/vitest.config.ts' 'packages/storybook/src' 'packages/storybook/vitest.config.ts' 'packages/napi/*.d.ts' 'packages/cli/bin/**/*.js' 'apps/oracle/src'"
ts_tests_only := "'packages/vite-plugin/tests' 'packages/storybook/tests' 'apps/oracle/tests'"
md_src := "'**/*.md' '!node_modules/**' '!target/**' '!dist/**'"

# Lint and format check
lint:
    cargo fmt --check
    cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
    pnpm exec oxfmt --check {{ts_src}}
    pnpm exec oxfmt --check {{md_src}}
    pnpm exec oxlint {{ts_src_only}}
    pnpm exec oxlint -A pedantic -A perf -A style -A unicorn/consistent-function-scoping -A vitest/require-mock-type-parameters --vitest-plugin {{ts_tests_only}}

# Format code
fmt:
    cargo fmt
    pnpm exec oxfmt {{ts_src}}
    pnpm exec oxfmt {{md_src}}

# Check licenses, advisories, and banned crates
deny:
    cargo deny check

# Check for typos
typos:
    typos

# Lint GitHub Actions workflows for permission, credential, and supply-chain
# issues. --strict-collection fails on a workflow it cannot parse instead of
# skipping it, so a malformed file can never pass by being ignored.
zizmor:
    zizmor --offline --strict-collection .

# Everything the moon-managed pre-commit hook runs. `.moon/workspace.yml`
# calls this recipe rather than repeating the commands, so the hook and
# `just ci` can't drift apart.
pre-commit:
    cargo fmt --check
    cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
    typos
    cargo deny check

# Everything the CI jobs run, minus the Node version matrix and verify-install
ci: lint test deny typos zizmor doc-check machete semver msrv (coverage "90")

# Time and memory of this checkout (or a branch) against origin/main on Mantine and Chakra; see docs/measurement.md.
bench *args:
    python3 scripts/bench.py {{args}}

# Clean build artifacts
clean:
    moon clean
    cargo clean
    rm -rf node_modules

# Setup toolchain via proto
setup:
    proto install
    pnpm install
    moon sync vcs-hooks

# Run moon commands
moon *args:
    moon {{args}}

# Run cargo commands
cargo *args:
    cargo {{args}}
